name: Token Perturbation Guidance (TPG)
plain: An extra positive pass in which spatial tokens are randomly shuffled inside each patched transformer block. Like PAG but with no attention swap.
math:
In patched blocks when option on: x ← x[:,randperm]
x̂_s = M(x; c); G = w(x̂_c − x̂_s); x̂ = x̂_cfg + rescaled G (or SNF).

props.params: scale=3.0, sigma_start, sigma_end, rescale, rescale_mode, unet_block_list=d2.2-9,d3
